$comment: Companion record to docs/adr/002-classes-key-vocabulary.md. Keys that no prop combination drives into the DOM, with the reason. Governed by ADR 002 R7/R8: these are candidates for deletion in the vocabulary phase, NOT deleted here. fixtures.contract fails if a waived key becomes reachable, so this list cannot rot. Two reason classes: 'dead' — the key is declared but no source line renders it, verified by reference count; 'state-gated' — the key renders only in a state jsdom cannot reach (pointer capture, hover, layout measurement) and needs an e2e or a prop the component does not expose.

CascadingDropdown.content: dead — zero source references; duplicates the menu vocabulary (AUDIT-GAP §4.5)
CascadingDropdown.option: dead — zero source references; superseded by menuItem
CascadingDropdown.optionSelected: dead — zero source references; superseded by menuItem + data-selected under ADR 002 R4
CascadingDropdown.optionFocused: dead — zero source references; superseded by menuItem + data-highlighted under ADR 002 R4
CascadingDropdown.optionDisabled: dead — zero source references; superseded by menuItem + data-disabled under ADR 002 R4
CascadingDropdown.menuItemSelected: state-gated — needs a selection inside a portalled submenu; ADR 002 R4 replaces it with data-selected
CascadingDropdown.menuItemDisabled: state-gated — ADR 002 R4 replaces it with data-disabled
CascadingDropdown.submenuItemFocused: state-gated — keyboard highlight inside a submenu; ADR 002 R4 replaces it with data-highlighted

DatePicker.navButtonDisabled: dead — zero source references; ADR 002 R4 replaces it with data-disabled
DatePicker.dayHover: dead — zero source references; a :hover utility on `day` is the idiomatic replacement
DatePicker.dayFocused: state-gated — grid focus, and DatePicker calls .focus() nowhere at all (AUDIT-GAP §3.1), so no interaction can reach it until focus management lands
DatePicker.markerTooltip: state-gated — needs a hover over a marked day plus positioning

InternationalPhoneInput.countrySelectNoResults: state-gated — needs a search string matching no country inside the nested SearchableDropdown, and IPI exposes no path to set it

Slider.thumbActive: state-gated — gated on isDragging, which needs pointer capture; jsdom implements no PointerEvent capture. ADR 002 R4 replaces it with data-state

Table.pinIcon: state-gated — column pin controls paint on header hover, which needs layout
Table.pinIconHover: state-gated — same; ADR 002 R4 makes this a :hover utility on pinIcon
Table.pinnedPinIcon: state-gated — same, for an already-pinned column
Table.pinnedPinIconHover: state-gated — same; ADR 002 R4 makes this a :hover utility
Table.editInput: state-gated — cell edit mode opens on double-click and needs a measured cell

Breadcrumb.itemDisabled: state-gated — applied to a disabled crumb that is not the current page; ADR 002 R4 replaces it with data-disabled

RadioButton/RadioButton.error: dead — the radio item never renders error text; the group does, from DEFAULT_RADIO_GROUP_CLASSES.error. Surfaced once the registry stopped reading only the first class set.
RadioButton/RadioButton.success: dead — same, the group owns the success message

$comment2: decorativeLeaks: tokens that survive `unstyled` because they are written as literals at a JSX call site rather than declared in a constants file. Every one is already counted by constants.contract's ratcheting baseline (125 literals, 92 of them structural), which is the gate that owns them; they are recorded here so unstyled.contract names them rather than silently excluding them. Both ratchets move DOWN only, and unstyled.contract fails if a token listed here stops leaking.
$comment3: motionLeaks: animation utilities that survive prefers-reduced-motion because they are written as literals at a JSX site (constants.contract's ratcheting baseline owns those) or because they come from a nested component the parent does not yet pass `unstyled` to (GATE-HONESTY §4, deferred). Neither is fixable inside the reduced-motion work without touching code that is out of scope, so they are named here rather than hidden. reduced-motion.contract fails if an entry stops leaking.
$comment5: axeBaseline: accessibility violations recorded against fixture pages, by violation id, with the cause. e2e/accessibility.spec.ts fails on anything not listed, and on a listed entry that stops firing, so the list ratchets down only. Recorded rather than fixed where the fix is a design decision (the --cl-text-tertiary value) or sits in an area this phase does not touch (the combobox pattern).

button-name.cause: InternationalPhoneInput's country trigger is a role=combobox button with no accessible name. The combobox pattern is explicitly out of scope for this phase (AUDIT-GAP 3.3/3.4).

$comment6: axeFixtureExpectations: which FIXTURES may carry which axe rule in the full sweep (e2e/accessibility-full.spec.ts, project a11y-full). Per-fixture, not per-rule: a rule waived globally would have hidden Avatar/with-status, which announced nothing. A finding on any fixture not listed here fails; a listed fixture that stops reporting fails too, so the list ratchets down.

label.reason: The fixture renders a bare control on purpose and must keep doing so — the library cannot force a consumer to label anything, and an external <label for> is legitimate. The silence was the defect, and it is fixed: these components now warn in dev via src/utils/useAccessibleNameWarning.ts. Every `labelled` fixture of each component is clean.

label-title-only.reason: The same defect as `label`, reported under a different rule: `showCount` adds `aria-describedby`, and axe faults a described-but-unnamed control here. Neither Input nor TextArea sets a `title` attribute — verified — and nothing in the docs or .ai.md files proposes `title` as a labelling mechanism. Covered by the same dev warning, which calls out `title` explicitly.

button-name.reason: 56 of these are the role=combobox trigger with no accessible name, across six components — the combobox pattern, out of scope (AUDIT-GAP 3.3/3.4). The other 3 are Switch's role=switch button in the fixtures that pass no label, the same case as `label` above.
